snippet.title: Escape the Backrooms - After Party Update Trailer | The Triple-i Initiative
snippet.description:
Learn more about Escape the Backrooms: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1943950/Escape_the_Backrooms/

This December, Escape the Backrooms drops its biggest content update yet: You are invited to the After Party, a brand-new liminal space to survive with up to three friends, packed with fresh threats, puzzles, and secrets. Join 10 million+ players already enjoying being lost in the Backrooms on Steam, XBOX Series X|S, PlayStation 5, and Nintendo Switch 2, published by Secret Mode.

Escape The Backrooms Store Pages:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1943950/Escape_the_Backrooms/
PlayStation: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10010992
XBOX: https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/escape-the-backrooms/9mw15l8frt9p
Nintendo: https://www.nintendo.com/en-gb/Games/Nintendo-Switch-2-games/Escape-the-Backrooms-3135534.html

--

Follow news and updates on The Triple-i Initiative:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/sale/triple-i-initiative-2026 
Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/iii-initiative.bsky.social 
Bilibili: https://space.bilibili.com/3546638813497663
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/iii_initiative/
Twitter: https://x.com/iii_initiative

What is the Triple-i Initiative?

We’re simply a bunch of studios banding together to share exciting news to our players, in a short show packed with back-to-back trailers. That’s it - no extra fluff, no ads, no host, just games. We’re talking world premieres, exclusive gameplay, launch dates, demo drops and more!

You can learn more at https://iii-initiative.com
